Frequently Asked Questions 
 
Q: What is Home Remittance/Does HBL offer Home Remittance Service in Pakistan? 
 
HBL’s Home Remittance Service enables remitters to send money from abroad to Pakistan instantly, 
conveniently, and safely through the legal banking channel. 
 
Q: What types of Inward Home Remittance products does HBL offer? 
 
HBL offers the following Home Remittance Products to cater to the needs of various home remittance 
beneficiaries in Pakistan: 
 
• 
Cash Over the Counter (CoC) payments for walk-in customers 
• 
HBL Account Transfer 
• 
Other Bank Account Transfer via Inter Bank Funds Transfer (IBFT) & Real Time Gross Settlement 
(RTGS) 
• 
Konnect Home Remittance Account 
 
Q: In which currency will I receive my remittance? 
 
All home remittance payments are disbursed in Pak Rupees. 
 
Q: Is there any limit on the amount received though HBL Home Remittance? 
 
Below are the applicable limits: 
 
• 
HBL Accounts - No Limit 
• 
Other banks accounts - No Limit 
• 
Cash Over the Counter (CoC) Transactions - Up to PKR 500,000/- per transaction 
• 
Konnect Home Remittance Account - a maximum balance limit of PKR 1,500,000/- at any point of 
time 
 
Q: Are there any charges/fee for HBL’s Home Remittance Service? 
 
HBL Home Remittance Service is free of charge. 
 
Q: Are there any tax deductions on Home Remittances? 
 
Home Remittance Service is free of taxes. 
 
Q: Can I receive remittance in Pakistan if I do not have a bank account with any bank? 
 
You can receive your home remittance from any of HBL’s 1,600+ domestic branches nationwide if you 
have a valid CNIC and Transaction Unique Reference No. / Pin code. The existing limit for a remittance is 
PKR 500,000/- per cash transaction via HBL’s Cash Over the Counter (CoC) service. The list of HBL’s 
domestic branches can be viewed from the Branch Locator available on our corporate website 
www.hbl.com . 
 
Q: Who should I contact in case I need to lodge a complaint regarding Home Remittance?

Centre 
at

may 
also

Q: How can I obtain a Proceed Realization Certificate (PRC)/Encashment Certificate against 
remittance(s) received from HBL? Who should I contact? 
 
Please find below contact details for obtaining a PRC and e-PRC: 
 
• 
Proceeds Realization Certificate (PRC) is issued from HBL Centralized Remittance Department 
(CRD) Head Office Karachi. You may contact them at the following email addresses: 
home.remittance@hbl.com 
cird.prc@hbl.com 
 
• 
e-PRC option is also available at the HBL website https://rda.hbl.com/eprcverification to obtain a 
system generated PRC on your registered email address. 
 
Q: What should I do if a home remittance is not traceable at the branch end? 
 
You can contact HBL Remittance Service Centre on UAN: 021-111-555-425. You can also email your query 
at home.remittance@hbl.com for the required assistance. 
 
Q: Can I track my remittance status online? 
 
Yes, you can view the status of your remittance online through HBL Remittance Tracker by following the 
steps below: 
 
• 
Log on to https://www.hbl.com/ 
• 
Click on “Remittance Tracker” option 
• 
Input your transaction reference number in the “Unique Reference #” tab 
• 
Click on the “Search” button to view the current status of your remittance transaction 
 
Q: What are HBL’s Banking hours to avail home remittance services from HBL Branches? 
 
Customers can avail home remittance services from HBL domestic branches during regular 
business hours appended below: 
 
• 
Monday to Thursday: 09:00 am to 05:30 pm 
• 
Friday: 09:00 am to 06:00 pm 
• 
Saturday: 09:00 am to 01:30 pm (through selected branches)
